lift.description: Source-internalize m3kit libs (plus their dependency closure) into the current workspace and rewire aliases, tags, and theme includePaths.

component.description: Scaffold an on-contract m3kit component (standalone, signals, OnPush, m3k- selector, token-only SCSS) with spec, stories, and cy coverage.

brand.description: Scaffold a brand SCSS module pair implementing the m3kit-theme contract, and print (or apply, inside m3kit) the registration steps.

report-page.description: Scaffold an app-side report page (page-header + filter-form + data-table) wired to a TableDefinition and datasource stub.

dashboard-page.description: Scaffold an app-side dashboard page (page-header + KPI cards + chart cards) wired to KPI and chart series stubs.

port-analyze.description: Analyze one Angular/Nx page and emit a non-destructive m3kit app-porting packet.

port-page.description: Generate side-by-side m3kit feature/data-access/ui app-porting scaffolds plus Spec Kit packet and runbook.
